limitations: No measurement says whether the tracks share a master, a mix or a source; the Report draws no such conclusion.
MP3 is lossy: the measurements of an MP3 depend on its decoder.
Tracks at different sample rates are compared at the lower rate, after resampling, so differences above that rate's band are not measured.
One global offset aligns the tracks: inserted or removed sections, drift and speed changes are not located; they lower the correlation and raise the residual.
Channels are paired in the order each file stores them.
